proposals.before: Dụng cụ có hình dạng để đo so sánh đường kính trong.
proposals.after: Dụng cụ đo có cấu tạo phù hợp để đo so sánh đường kính trong.
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 内径の比較測定に使う形状の測定器。
proposals.reason: Replace unnatural “có hình dạng để” while retaining the instrument’s comparative internal-diameter role.

proposals.before: Alat berbentuk untuk pengukuran pembanding diameter dalam.
proposals.after: Alat ukur yang bentuknya sesuai untuk pengukuran pembanding diameter dalam.
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 内径の比較測定に使う形状の測定器。
proposals.reason: Restore grammatical explanation of instrument configuration; no operating specification added.

proposals.after: Indikator sifat asam atau basa suatu larutan berair.
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 水溶液の酸性やアルカリ性を示す指標。
proposals.reason: Restore the aqueous-solution condition 水溶液 omitted in “larutan”.

proposals.before: Tỷ số khối lượng riêng với chất tham chiếu.
proposals.after: Tỷ số giữa khối lượng riêng của chất đang xét và khối lượng riêng của chất chuẩn.
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 基準物質の密度に対する密度の比。
proposals.reason: Explicitly preserve density in both numerator and denominator, not a ratio of density to a substance.

proposals.after: Perbandingan massa jenis suatu zat terhadap massa jenis zat acuan.
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 基準物質の密度に対する密度の比。
proposals.reason: Restore reference-substance density as the denominator, rather than an unspecified reference.

proposals.before: Tỷ số không thứ nguyên giữa khối lượng riêng của chất với chất chuẩn.
proposals.after: Tỷ số không thứ nguyên giữa khối lượng riêng của chất và khối lượng riêng của chất chuẩn.
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 密度と基準物質の密度との無次元の比。
proposals.reason: Restore explicit density denominator while retaining dimensionless character.

proposals.before: Rasio tanpa dimensi antara densitas zat dan bahan acuan.
proposals.after: Rasio tanpa dimensi antara massa jenis suatu zat dan massa jenis zat acuan.
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 密度と基準物質の密度との無次元の比。
proposals.reason: Restore explicit density denominator rather than wording that compares density to a reference material itself.

proposals.before: อัตราความหนาแน่นต่อสารอ้างไร้มิติ
proposals.after: อัตราส่วนไร้มิติระหว่างความหนาแน่นของสารกับความหนาแน่นของสารอ้างอิง
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 密度と基準物質の密度との無次元の比。
proposals.reason: Restore density on both sides of the dimensionless ratio.

proposals.before: Bahan gabungan logam dengan pemuaian berbeda.
proposals.after: Bahan yang dibuat dengan menyatukan logam-logam dengan pemuaian termal berbeda.
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 熱膨張が異なる金属を接合した材料。
proposals.reason: Restore thermal expansion, not unspecified expansion, and the joined-metals relationship.

proposals.after: Kecepatan medan magnet berputar yang ditentukan oleh frekuensi sumber listrik dan jumlah kutub.
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 電源周波数と極数で決まる回転磁界の速度。
proposals.reason: Make supply frequency and pole count explicit instead of compressed “frekuensi/kutub”.

proposals.before: 调查相对基准的尺寸差或变化。
proposals.after: 通过测量确定相对于基准的尺寸差异或变化。
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 基準に対する寸法の差や変化を調べる測定。
proposals.reason: Use measurement terminology rather than the general verb 调查, retaining the dimension/reference relation.

proposals.before: 調查相對基準的尺寸差或變化。
proposals.after: 利用量測確認相對於基準的尺寸差異或變化。
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 基準に対する寸法の差や変化を調べる測定。
proposals.reason: Use measurement terminology rather than the general verb 調查, retaining the dimension/reference relation.

proposals.before: อะโนไดซ์มุ่งแข็งหรือทนสึกสูง
proposals.after: ประเภทของการอะโนไดซ์ที่มุ่งให้ได้สมบัติ เช่น ความแข็งสูงหรือความทนทานต่อการสึกหรอ
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 高い硬度や耐摩耗性などを狙う陽極酸化の区分。
proposals.reason: Restore the category and targeted-property meaning in a complete definition, without an operating recipe.

proposals.before: ออกไซด์โครเมียมใช้ขัดและอื่น
proposals.after: ออกไซด์ของโครเมียมที่ใช้เป็นอนุภาคขัดและในการใช้งานที่เกี่ยวข้อง
proposals.canonicalJapanese: 研磨粒子などに使われるクロムの酸化物。
proposals.reason: Restore abrasive-particle role from 研磨粒子 rather than only the general verb “polish”.
